article.body_preview:
DHAKA, Feb 6, 2023 (BSS) - The general point-to-point inflation rate in January eased further as it fell to 8.57 percentage points down from 8.71 percentage points last December mainly because of the downtrend in food and non-food inflation.

The general point-to-point inflation rate in November last was 8.85 percentage points, according to the monthly consumer price (CPI) index of the Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics (BBS).
